# Legocraft

Legocraft is an open-source browser-based 3D brick-building sandbox built with React Three Fiber, Three.js, TypeScript, and experimental WebXR.

Live application: https://legocraftvr.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/Joenasriani/legocraft

## Project documentation

- README: https://github.com/Joenasriani/legocraft/blob/main/README.md
- Architecture: https://github.com/Joenasriani/legocraft/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- Contributing: https://github.com/Joenasriani/legocraft/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- WebXR / Quest QA: https://github.com/Joenasriani/legocraft/blob/main/docs/QUEST_QA.md

## Scope

The project includes grid-snapped 3D brick placement, generated brick geometry, selection and editing workflows, local persistence, JSON project files, GLB export, touch and desktop interaction, and experimental WebXR controller interaction.

Meta Quest hardware compatibility has not yet been validated on real hardware.
